text:
I lost your presence,

but I will find it;

for hidden science

tells my conscience

that in another existence

I will recover you.


You were on my path

the only pledge

I never sought;

you came to my tent

with your noble offering,

who knows why!


Alas, for how many and many

chimeras I yearned

that I never achieved...

and instead you, holy one,

sweet beloved blessing,

I found at my side,

who knows why!


You came, you loved me;

ten years you loved me;

ten years you filled

my life with faith,

with light and fragrance;

in my soul you cooed

like a dove,

who knows why!


And one day you went away:

alas, sad one, alas, sad!

but I will find you;

for hidden science

tells my conscience

that in another existence

I will recover you.

translation.title: Who Knows Why!
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the refrain as wonder at love found and faith in reunion.
